summary: D007 is disciplined and no-number, but its Station Datum / first-staff anchor becomes a clean source-defined metaphor. The repeated failed live reach is sharper and should become material rather than a disclosure afterthought.
strengths: Removes the D006 numeric hinge and witness/oath courtroom frame.
Uses NOAA's Station Datum / zero of the first tide staff definition as a real source anchor.
Finds a strong pressure in the first staff being gone or not gone enough while its zero remains.
failures: Explains the definition into safety and abstraction.
Repeats familiar conceptual nouns: truth, mercy, fact, question, floor.
Leaves the cloudtainer's failed live reach as late disclosure-like material instead of letting it reorganize the poem.
required_next_change: D008 should keep the Station Datum / first tide staff anchor while moving the local DNS/name-resolution failure into the poem body as material, without inventing or implying a live NOAA water-level value.
non_claim: This review blocks promotion; it is not an admission or evidence judgment.
